title: Carina Nebula
description: This broad panorama of the Carina Nebula, a region of massive star formation in the southern skies, was taken in infrared light using the HAWK-I camera on ESO’s Very Large Telescope. Many previously hidden features, scattered across a spectacular celestial landscape of gas, dust and young stars, have emerged. Some of these features have been annotated in Commons . Trumpler 16 (annotated) is an open cluster that contains the luminous, massive blue variable Eta Carinae, one of the brightest stars
author: ESO/T. Preibisch

title: Crab Nebula
description: This is a mosaic image, one of the largest ever taken by NASA's Hubble Space Telescope, of the Crab Nebula , a six-light-year-wide expanding remnant of a star's supernova explosion. Japanese and Chinese astronomers recorded this violent event in 1054 CE. The orange filaments are the tattered remains of the star and consist mostly of hydrogen.
